# netactuate_bgp_prefix (Data Source)

Reads a BGP Prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_prefix" "example" {
  bgp_prefix_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bgp_prefix_id` (Number) BGP prefix ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `agreement_id` (Number) Agreement ID used for the purchase.
- `anycast_profile` (Number) Anycast profile ID.
- `asn_id` (Number) BGP ASN ID.
- `group_id` (Number) BGP group ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Prefix name.
- `prefix` (String) BGP prefix.
